image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a disposable plastic lighter lying on its side on a white surface. The lighter has a translucent greyish-blue body with a black top guard and a silver metal windguard/shield featuring an embossed pattern. To the left of the main body, there is a detached or separate small block-like object with green, red, and white sections, resembling a stylized fuel canister or a decorative element, but it appears physically disconnected from the flame nozzle area in a way that defies standard lighter mechanics. There is faint text '68r16p6' in the bottom left corner.
